# rauthy_client (Data Source)

OIDC Client data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rauthy_client" "test" {
  id = "test-client"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the client

### Read-Only

- `access_token_alg` (String) Access token algorithm
- `access_token_lifetime` (Number) Access token lifetime
- `auth_code_lifetime` (Number) Auth code lifetime
- `challenges` (List of String) Challenges
- `client_uri` (String) Client URI
- `confidential` (Boolean) Whether the client is confidential
- `contacts` (List of String) Contacts
- `default_scopes` (List of String) Default scopes
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the client is enabled
- `flows_enabled` (List of String) Enabled flows
- `force_mfa` (Boolean) Force MFA
- `id_token_alg` (String) ID token algorithm
- `name` (String) The name of the client
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (List of String) Post logout redirect URIs
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Redirect URIs
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes
